newsitem.title: JAPAN: Chinon to allocate shares to Kodak Japan.
newsitem.headline: Chinon to allocate shares to Kodak Japan.

text.p: Japanese optical and scanner firm Chinon Industries Inc said on Thursday that it will allocate new shares to a Japan unit of Eastman Kodak Co.
The company also said in a statement that an executive of the Japan unit, Kodak Japan Ltd, would become a board director of Chinon, effective June 27.

In late April, Kodak announced it would raise its stake in Chinon to 50.09 percent from the current 12 percent by subscribing to a Chinon share issue of 9.91 million shares at 190 yen per share. Kodak is already the top shareholder of Chinon.
Kodak said it and Chinon, which has posted losses since 1991/92, would collaborate on engineering and development of digital cameras and scanners.
